title: Fix median for unsorted and even-length input
objective: median returns the true statistical median of a list of numbers
requirements: median sorts numerically: median([10, 9, 2]) is 9, not 2
an even-length list returns the mean of its two middle values
median does not reorder the caller's array
constraints: keep the named exports of src/stats.mjs

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given [10, 9, 2], when median is called, then it returns 9
Given [1, 2, 3, 4], when median is called, then it returns 2.5
Given an empty list, when median is called, then it throws a RangeError

plan: Write a failing regression test for median
repositoryFindings: median uses Array#sort without a comparator and sorts in place
